gist.headline: Seven quests, one page
gist.blurb: Pollinations Quest Starter puts the seven setup quests in one place. The API key stays in your browser; this little guide has no backend to feed.
gist.summary: Pollinations Quest Starter joins the learn listings as a zero-backend web app that guides new users through seven setup quests on one page and stores their API key only in browser localStorage.
gist.impact: New users get one place to follow all seven setup quests without giving the guide an API key to store on a server.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the seven setup quests as a short garden path of seven numbered stepping stones leading to a cozy browser window. Polli, wearing a tiny explorer's scarf, checks the path while a small key rests safely inside the browser window; no separate server appears.
